headline: Italy Invests €2 Million in Rescued Dogfighting Victims
meta_description: Italy commits €2 million to care, veterinary treatment, and rehabilitation for dogs rescued from illegal dogfighting rings.
summary_short: Italy is dedicating €2 million to help dogs rescued from illegal dogfighting receive veterinary care and behavioural rehabilitation.
body:
Italy is committing €2 million toward the care, veterinary treatment, and behavioural rehabilitation of dogs rescued from illegal dogfighting.

The investment recognizes the profound trauma these animals endure. Dogs used in fighting rings suffer severe physical injuries and psychological damage that requires specialized care and time to heal. Behavioural rehabilitation is especially critical—many rescued dogs need patient, expert work to rebuild trust and learn to live peacefully with humans and other animals.

This funding represents a meaningful recognition of animal welfare as a public good. By dedicating resources to rescue operations and recovery, Italy acknowledges both the suffering of these victims and the possibility of their transformation. For each dog that receives treatment and finds safety, the investment offers not just survival, but genuine healing.
quick_facts: Italy allocates €2 million for rescued dogfighting victims
Funds cover veterinary treatment and behavioural rehabilitation
Program supports dogs rescued from illegal fighting rings
